papers.title: Physics-Based porosity prediction in powder bed fusion – laser beam using a thermal simulation algorithm
papers.abstract: Powder Bed Fusion–Laser Beam (PBF-LB) is a widely used additive manufacturing technique that enables the fabrication of geometrically complex components, yet it remains susceptible to internal defects, particularly porosity, which can compromise mechanical performance. This study presents a physics-based thermal simulation algorithm developed to predict porosity in Ti6Al4V parts fabricated via PBF-LB without relying on extensive training datasets. The algorithm numerically solves the transient three-dimensional heat conduction problem using the finite volume method, incorporating temperature-dependent material properties, a Gaussian-distributed laser heat source, and relevant thermal loss mechanisms. To validate the predictive capability of the model, six Ti6Al4V specimens were fabricated under varying process parameters using a PBF-LB system, and porosity levels were experimentally evaluated through Archimedes density measurements and high-resolution X-ray micro-Computed Tomography (µ-CT). Additional characterization by Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM), optical microscopy, and Energy-Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy (EDS) was performed on cross-sectioned subsurface regions to assess pore morphology and elemental homogeneity. The porosity values predicted by the simulation algorithm exhibited strong agreement with experimental findings in terms of trend and ranking, with predicted porosity ranging from 4.78% to 15.75% and µ-CT results ranging from 3.54% to 13.41%, thereby demonstrating the model’s effectiveness in capturing the relative impact of process parameters on porosity formation in PBF-LB fabricated components.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文针对Ti6Al4V的PBF-LB工艺孔隙率预测，与方向中缺陷/孔隙率相关，但未涉及力学性能测试或建模。
llm.why_not_core: No direct measurement or modeling of mechanical properties such as tensile strength, ductility, or fatigue life; focuses solely on porosity prediction without linking to mechanical performance.

summary_zh.motivation: 针对PBF-LB制造Ti6Al4V零件中孔隙缺陷影响力学性能的问题，提出基于热模拟的孔隙率预测方法。
summary_zh.method: 采用有限体积法求解瞬态三维热传导问题，结合高斯热源和温度依赖材料属性，预测孔隙率。
summary_zh.result: 预测孔隙率与实验µ-CT结果趋势一致，范围4.78%-15.75%及3.54%-13.41%。
summary_zh.validation: 通过Archimedes密度测量和µ-CT实验验证模拟预测的孔隙率。

summary_en.motivation: To address porosity defects in PBF-LB Ti6Al4V parts that compromise mechanical performance, a physics-based thermal simulation algorithm is developed for porosity prediction.
summary_en.method: The algorithm solves the transient 3D heat conduction equation using the finite volume method with a Gaussian heat source and temperature-dependent material properties.
summary_en.result: Predicted porosity (4.78-15.75%) agrees well in trend with experimental µ-CT measurements (3.54-13.41%).
summary_en.validation: The model is validated by Archimedes density and µ-CT data from six Ti6Al4V specimens.
